opening.argument: The speaker presents paid OneCoin packages as mining participation whose value and coin returns supposedly improve for early buyers. He announces that package prices will rise, stating, "Packages will be increased by 10%. for example, if a Tycoon currently priced for 5,000€ the new price from the 1st of April will be 5,500€," while linking "the higher the mining difficulty and the higher the price of the coin." He then presses early entry, saying, "the earlier you join OneCoin, the earlier you start the mining, the better for you." The opportunity is further framed through personal sales incentives, including a 10% startup bonus, and claims of substantial commissions: "In 1Coin we have created more than 300 millionaires." This combines paid participation, urgency, network growth and commission-based earnings into a lucrative financial pitch.
